rv.q: This carefully presented production teaches both parents and children the value of truth...telling the truth is a path towards showing people the real you.
It’s really gorgeous and prepares the audience for a full Technicolor experience. ... The young audience’s audible response to such visual delights is hugely heartening.

With Follies providing the perfect Christmas treat for grown ups in the National Theatre's biggest auditorium, there's now a major family show in the proscenium arch venue, the Lyttelton. It's Pinocchio, the classic story of a wooden puppet who faces many perils in his quest to become human.
It’s a colourful, dynamic show with a great cast, yet ultimately it feels like it needs a little more work to achieve an overall balance.
